The other route through the Wicklow Mountains from east to west is the Wicklow Gap which is crossed by the R756.\nThe highest point on the road is at the Sally Gap where it crosses the Military Road (R115), 503m (1,650 ft) (53.1376°N 6.3120°W﻿ / 53.1376; -6.3120).  The road passes through some spectacular scenery, including the corrie lake of Lough Tay below Luggala mountain, in the Guinness Estate; the road gives access to several woodlands car-parks at Lough Tay, which are used to access the mountains around Djouce. The moorlands of the Sally Gap plateau, the Liffey Head Bog on the slopes of Tonduff, form the source of the River Liffey.
